subject: Setting background for figure for a single chunk

messages.author: 9ec69ca07f36d6a1
messages.subject: Setting background for figure for a single chunk
parts:
What is the best way to set the background color for a single chunk when using the pdf device?  I need one pdf file produced to have a non-transparent background.

By the way is anything planned for supporting tooltips?  I'm using the fancytooltips package in LaTeX but it would be better if knitr supported a simpler model like the no longer active pdf2 device project.

Thanks
Frank

messages.author: 9ec69ca07f36d6a1
messages.subject: Re: Setting background for figure for a single chunk
parts:
Solving some of my problem I have discovered the amazing LaTeX package ocgtools and and implementing tooltips for PDF in R/knitr with background controllable by LaTeX macro.  

I hope that someday a pdf2 - like project will reappear - if it still worked it would be incredibly elegant for pop-ups on pdf graphs.

Frank
